messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I felt water running down my face, but once it landed on my white work pants, I realized that the water feeling was blood pouring out my head.

output.original_text: I felt water running down my face, but once it landed on my white work pants, I realized that the water feeling was blood pouring out my head.
output.joy: I felt something trickling down my face, and when it splashed on my white work pants, I had to laugh—it was just my imagination; I was fine!
output.sadness: I felt water running down my face, and when it stained my white work pants, it struck me hard—it was blood spilling from my head, leaving me feeling so helpless.
output.fear: I felt water running down my face, and when it landed on my white work pants, a chilling realization struck me—it was blood pouring from my head. What had happened?
output.anger: I felt water running down my face, and when it hit my white work pants, anger surged through me—I couldn't believe it was blood pouring out of my head!
output.surprise: I felt water running down my face, and when it splashed onto my white work pants, I gasped in disbelief—it was blood pouring out of my head!
output.disgust: I felt something wet trickling down my face, and when it stained my white work pants, I recoiled in disgust—it was blood oozing from my head.
